reviews.body: Found one P2 test-coverage gap in the new search endpoint. All 9 tests and typechecking pass; the optional query parameter is compatible with the current invoices-web client.

comments.body:
🟡 **P2** · 🐛 **Bug**

The new tests only check the string returned by `containsPattern`; none call `GET /invoices` or exercise the SQL filter and count. Removing customer-name matching or dropping the search predicate from the count query would still leave every test green. Add endpoint tests for case-insensitive partial matches on both fields, literal `%`/`_`, combined `q`/`status`/`customer_id` filters, and a paginated result whose `total` includes only matches.
